To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“An increase in international oil price has a long run, positive effect on Russian banks’ stability, but a negative effect in the short run”.

(1) an increase in the oil prices and in banks' price to book value ratios contributes positively to bank stability in Russia in the long run; (2) an opposite effect is found for negative oil price shocks.
an increase in the international oil prices and the price-to-book ratio has a positive long run effect on Russian listed public bank financial stability, while a decrease has a negative effect.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of international oil prices on the stability of Russian banks, which are the main financial intermediaries of an oil-dependent country.
the long run impact of international oil prices on the financial stability of Russian public banks.

the impact of the macroeconomic environment, in particular of the international oil prices, on bank stability and bank valuation, and it contributes to the literature by providing evidence on the impact of oil prices on bank financial stability for an oil dependent economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
international oil prices have a positive long run impact on bank financial stability in an oil exporting country.
the international oil prices have a positive long run impact on the bank stability, but a negative short run impact.
international oil prices have a positive long run effect on Russian banks' financial stability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
an increase in oil prices is beneficial for bank stability.
a decrease in the oil price leads to a deterioration of banks' stability, which in turn negatively affects their valuation, as reflected by the price to book ratio.
the bank financial stability in an oil exporting country is positively affected by an increase in oil prices, while the opposite effect is documented for negative oil price shocks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
international oil prices affect bank stability through a complex mechanism.
the bank financial stability is affected in the long run by the oil prices.
the bank valuation and bank stability are affected by international oil prices, especially in oil exporting countries.
